sourceContradictions.details: Official GPX/API geo_json computes 10.984 km and official display is 11 km. Naturkartan displays 12.0 km; API line.geometry computes 12.3 km; OSM relation computes about 12.347 km.

agents.summary: Confirmed canonical Swedish official identity Kärnebygd - Ätran, 11 km, blue/medium, no time, official description/sights, shelter/water notes, 20 official places and stale English Kvarnlyckan/Naturkartan distance/API line.geometry caveats.

Confirmed official GPX/API geo_json as canonical 181-point 10.984 km planning-grade geometry with good M2/M4 continuity. Recommended suppressing API line.geometry and OSM relation 5604178 as old Kärnebygd-Eseredssjön linework.
Collected official/local/OSM facility records for Kärnebygd, Gunnarp, Ätran and Eseredssjön, including import decisions, side-distance caveats, water findings and pending/suppressed records.
Confirmed high-confidence Ätran bus access and weak/no-direct Kärnebygd access, with Horsared söder as official fallback and Lia/Obbhult as weaker closer straight-line alternatives.

Found thin field coverage and no recent exact-section condition report. Useful evidence was mainly stale segmentation clues from Wikiloc/Pacer/Naturkartan/local tourism and Eseredssjön facility context.

Found no direct protected-area overlap, Ätran endpoint water-protection overlap, no M3-specific closure/reroute, dynamic fire status, dog/livestock, hunting, road/farmland/high-stile and no-water-at-campsites caveats.
